descriptions.zh:
随着巨像完成其毁天灭地的任务，[From.From.GetName]因受到[From.GetName]地壳破裂与磁层分解的猛烈冲击而产生的微微晃动也平息了下来。

我们很难理解一颗星球死亡时的那种壮烈，但[From.GetName]炽热的核心在冰冷宇宙中冷却时的那种死亡之美是无可争辩的。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal beauty of [From.GetName]'s molten core cooling in gelid space is undeniable.

descriptions.zh: 超空间规划委员会报告，将太阳系的第三行星从重力井移除后，一个天然虫洞形成了。这个虫洞也许能逐渐缓解附近超空间通路的超光速交通拥堵。
descriptions.en: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.

label.zh: 这该死的行星，我完全没有同情它。
label.en: Apathetic bloody planet, I've no sympathy at all.

descriptions.zh:
从[From.From.GetName]发出的耀眼光束逐渐暗淡，[From.GetName]寂静无声。

也许历史会将这次屏蔽，这次将[From.GetName]从大宇宙完全隔离的行为，视作极端且不合理。也许也不会。不管如何，从现在起[From.GetStarName]星系有了一颗行星规模的水晶球。
descriptions.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. Or perhaps not. For now, the [From.GetStarName] system has a new planetary terrarium.

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]炫目的光芒已渐渐黯淡，[From.GetName]归于沉寂。

生活将在封闭的世界中继续。
descriptions.en:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Life goes on, if contained.

label.en: Tap on the glass and watch them squirm.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]地表上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去了。扫描显示未发现智慧生命迹象；植被虽被摧毁，但会逐渐恢复的。有些人会称这种彻底消灭智慧生命，只保留无机质的做法为邪恶的战争罪行。

我们将其称为高效。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total annihilation of intelligent life, while preserving inanimate matter, a perverse war crime.

We would call it efficient.

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]表面上的灭杀完成后，[From.From.GetName]上的中子羽流逐渐散去。

声波传感器只传输来风声和合成人的呼声。所有高等有机生命已被扫除。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

Sonic sensors relay nothing but the wind and the gentle clicks and whirrs of the surviving synthetic populace. All sapient organic life has been wiped out.

descriptions.zh:
完成了对[From.GetName]地表的灭杀之后，[From.From.GetName]的中子羽流渐渐消散。

快速扫描确认了曾遍布地表的扭曲翻腾的有机质，已经彻底失去活性，仅剩贫瘠的石堆。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

A quick scan confirms that the infested landscape, previously a roiling and writhing mass of organic activity, is now bereft of all life. Only barren rock remains.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]上的灵能的嗡声逐渐淡去，一瞬间万物寂静。[From.GetName]上的人群目瞪口呆（如果他们有眼和鼻的话），灵能射线从他们心智絮网中发散着，每个人都着迷于其强大和强烈的个人信仰。

如果他们之前不明白的话，现在他们知道了：我们都只是某个更伟大事物的一部分。
descriptions.en:
The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters from the tangled web of their minds.

If they did not understand before, they know now viscerally: we are all part of something greater.

descriptions.zh:
[From.From.GetName]已完成纳米同化机器人的部署，其数量经计算足以义体化支配[From.GetName]上所有智慧有机生命。

我们没有在[From.From.GetName]上布置任何传感器或器械以证明我们的成功，但我们知道已经成功了。当我们将目光投于[From.GetName]上时。我们见到了自己，也经由自己所见。

在[From.GetName]表面上，只有我们自己。
descriptions.en:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to measure our success, but we know. We open our eyes for the first time down on [From.GetName]. We see ourselves and are seen by ourselves.

On [From.GetName]'s surface, there is only us.

tooltips.zh: 所有£pop£§H有机人口§!获得§Y义体人§!特质。

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]曾是圣地。


你们不明白你们犯下了多大的罪恶。


不过马上就会了。
descriptions.en:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.

label.zh: 我们会展示我们的正统性的。

label.en: It was just a planetary body.

label.zh: 这只是战术，不是公报私仇。
我们需要一个预警措施。
你的星球很不错，但下一秒就是我的了。
label.en: That was yours? Well, not anymore.

label.zh: 你那小小的圣地不会再剩下什么了。
label.en: Nothing you hold sacred shall remain.

label.zh: 一颗星球有什么大不了的？
label.en: What is but a single world?

label.zh: 就像垃圾数据一样被清理了。
label.en: Erased, like so much junk data.

label.zh: 异端邪说只有烧尽一途。
label.en: Old heresies will do naught but burn.

descriptions.zh: 随着从[FromFrom.GetName]上下降的水柱消散，[From.GetName]的表面完全改变了。曾经有广阔缺水的大陆，现在只有崭新闪耀着欢迎的微光的蓝色海洋，随时可以居住。
descriptions.en: As the column of water descending from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipates, the surface of [From.GetName] is wholly transformed. Where once there were sprawling continents bereft of water, now there is only the welcoming shimmer of pristine, blue ocean ready to be inhabited.

tooltips.zh:
星球变为§Y海洋星球§!。
没有§Y水生§!特质的人口全部死亡。
tooltips.en:
The planet becomes an §YOcean World§!.
All Pops lacking the §YAquatic§! trait die.

descriptions.zh: 来自[FromFrom.GetName]的滔天毒流渐渐平息，[From.GetName]上生意盎然的生态系统不复存在，充满毒气的星球中唯有少数几种生命形式能繁衍生息。
descriptions.en: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 随着[FromFrom.GetName]发出的意识清除光束的能量逐渐消散，[From.GetName]的人口几乎都已经退化到了未开智状态。幸免遇难者面对那些曾经认识的人们做出动物般的举动只能束手无策。
descriptions.en: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic behaviors.

descriptions.zh: 尽管对[GetPreFTLLower]文明使用超级武器非常有趣，但这也意味着那里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
descriptions.en: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

descriptions.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队摧毁了[From.GetName]的[From.GetPlanetMoon]，杀害了滋生在星球表面的[GetPreFTLLower]文明。结果就是，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
descriptions.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have destroyed the [From.GetPlanetMoon] of [From.GetName], killing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on the surface. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

descriptions.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将[From.GetName]包裹在了不可穿透的护盾中，使得我们不可能继续对滋生在星球表面上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明继续进行观测……
descriptions.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have encased [From.GetName] in an impenetrable shield, making it impossible for us to continue observing the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization flourishing on the surface...

descriptions.zh: [FromFrom.Owner.GetName]的部队已经将滋生在[From.GetName]的[GetPreFTLLower]文明进行了清除。结果，这里已经没什么剩下的可供观测了……
descriptions.en: The forces of the [FromFrom.Owner.GetName] have wiped out the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization that flourished on [From.GetName]. As a result, there is now nothing left to observe there...

label.zh: 对于那些被飞速转化为等离子体的人来说他们表现的不错。
label.en: They flail pretty well for those being flash-converted to plasma.
